NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@gltf-transform/cli
License: MIT, copyright Don McCurdy; https://github.com/donmccurdy/glTF-Transform/blob/main/LICENSE.md
CLI package manifest reviewed: packages/cli/package.json (version 4.5.1 at the reviewed commit).

This Skill **does not redistribute the full upstream GitHub project**, its npm dependencies or binary. Use the included `scripts/get_official_gltf_transform_source.sh` when network is available and install the published CLI yourself. The included worker invokes official subcommands and verifies a game asset's structural integrity after processing.
